commands.name: workflow-bash-syntax
command:
mkdir -p out/release_offline
ORIGINAL_ID="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "resense:$TAG")"
START="$SECONDS"
docker build --network none --pull=false --progress=plain \
  --build-arg "RELEASE_IMAGE=resense:$TAG" \
  -f docker/Dockerfile.offline -t resense:release-offline-check . 2>&1 | tee out/release_offline/build.log
echo "seconds=$((SECONDS - START))" | tee -a "$GITHUB_OUTPUT" out/release_offline/timing.txt
docker run --rm --network none -w / resense:release-offline-check \
  python3 /opt/resense/scripts/check_offline_image.py | tee out/release_offline/installed.log
# Real changed-source test: a new native symbol, Python modules and launch/config data.
# An old wheel or setuptools/colcon cache must not make this check pass.
python3 scripts/offline_rebuild_test.py --base-image "resense:$TAG" \
  --image resense:release-offline-mutation-check --out out/release_offline/mutation
for IMAGE in "resense:$TAG" resense:release-offline-check; do
  docker run --rm --network none --user 1000:1000 -w / "$IMAGE" \
    python3 /opt/resense/scripts/check_nonroot_player.py 2>&1 | tee "out/release_offline/nonroot-${IMAGE##*:}.log"
done
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "resense:$TAG")" = "$ORIGINAL_ID"

commands.name: release-unit-linux
command: pip3 install pytest==8.4.2 && PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest -q -rs /opt/resense/tests/test_release.py

commands.name: native-unit-linux
command: pip3 install pytest==8.4.2 && PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 python3 -m pytest -q -rs /opt/resense/tests/test_native.py -k "not track_stage_functions_identical and not detector_output_identical"
